snippet.title: Shelf Heroes Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Shelf Heroes is a Roguelite FPS where your limbs are the loot. Swap a part mid-fight to build wild perk combos from modular pieces and blast enemies to plastic bits. A gameplay trailer aired during the Spring Showcase, offering co-operative gameplay and a glimpse at the game's meticulous art style. Shelf Heroes is coming soon to PC.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3151140/Shelf_Heroes/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
